question: What is the average number of singers per concert, including concerts with no listed performers?
reference_sql: WITH concert_counts AS (SELECT c.concert_ID, COUNT(DISTINCT sic.Singer_ID) AS singer_count FROM concert AS c LEFT JOIN singer_in_concert AS sic ON c.concert_ID = sic.concert_ID GROUP BY c.concert_ID) SELECT AVG(singer_count) FROM concert_counts
candidate_sql:
SELECT AVG(singer_count) AS average_singers_per_concert
FROM (
    SELECT c.concert_ID, COUNT(DISTINCT sic.Singer_ID) AS singer_count
    FROM concert AS c
    LEFT JOIN singer_in_concert AS sic
        ON c.concert_ID = sic.concert_ID
    GROUP BY c.concert_ID
) AS concert_counts;
